title: Documents of shipment {number}

list.for: Shipment {number} · {sent}. Choose a document to read it here.

logged: Opening or downloading a document here is recorded for the sender.

failed.title: The document could not be shown
failed.body: Something went wrong while reading it. Try again, or download it.

pdf.notPdf: This file cannot be shown in the page: download it to open it.

empty.title: No document shared yet
empty.body: The sender has not shared any document of shipment {number} on this link yet.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: This link expired on {time}. You can ask for a new one.
expired.bodyNoTime: This link has expired. You can ask for a new one.

withdrawn.title: This link no longer opens
withdrawn.body: It may have been withdrawn by the sender or used up. You can ask for a new one.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.body: The documents could not be read. Try again.

ask.label: Ask for a new link
ask.done: We passed this on. If the link was ours, the sender will write to the address it was sent to.
ask.failed: Your request did not reach us. Check the connection and ask again.
ask.onlyOnFile: A new link only ever goes to the address the documents were sent to, never to one typed here.
